subject: Error while reading a HDFS CSV file into R

messages.author: 6f2082f13e0d68d6
messages.subject: Error while reading a HDFS CSV file into R
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to read a HDFS CSV file, I am getting an error saying "Error in value[[3L]](cond) : line 1 did not have 11 elements" but in first line I could see 11 elements. below is the code I used.

#Testing to read a dataset from HDFS CSV file
library("catdata")
data(glass)
glass
write.table(glass,"/hdfs/glass.csv",sep=",")
#@Terminal fs -put /hdfs/glass.csv /hdfs/hdfp/glass.csv

from.dfs("/hdfs/hdfp/glass.csv",make.input.format(format ="csv",sep=","))
